title: Harden the launcher: no working-directory bunfig.toml or .env before Ward runs
description: Found in review of PR #1 (WCLI-2). Ward launched through `bun` reads the current directory's bunfig.toml and .env before main.ts runs: a planted preload executes arbitrary code with argv in reach, a malformed bunfig.toml is echoed to stderr, and .env is loaded into process.env. Ward runs inside repositories an agent can edit, so this is the product's trust boundary, not a dev nuisance. Ship a compiled launcher built with --no-compile-autoload-dotenv and --no-compile-autoload-bunfig (tsconfig and package.json autoload are already off by default) and never advertise a bun-shebang entry.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The shipped ward binary is built with bunfig and .env autoload disabled, and package.json bin resolves to it, not to TypeScript source

A test runs the packaged binary in a directory containing a bunfig.toml preload that throws with argv and a .env defining a sentinel: the preload never runs, no sentinel reaches stdout/stderr, and process.env lacks the .env key
Positive control: the same test run against `bun src/cli/main.ts` fails
